predecessor.limitation: Only four nonconsecutive UTC days were available. Those four days are excluded in full from Round 15 because their terminal targets were already observed.

scope.hypothesis: Causal public Binance BTCUSDT spot and USD-M perpetual flow available during a Polymarket BTC five-minute event predicts the jointly verified official endpoint better than target-blind calendar and training-prevalence controls on a never-observed chronological holdout.
scope.independence: Polymarket market identity, labels, risk, wallet, ledger, execution, reconciliation, and settlement remain independent. Binance supplies optional public read-only BTC observations only and has no credentials, account, order, balance, position, capital, PnL, risk, or execution authority.

source_contract.binance_availability_rule: A completed second becomes available only at second_ms plus 1000 milliseconds.

target_contract.label: Up when official terminal CLOB and Gamma evidence both identify the Up token as the unique winner; Down when both identify Down.
target_contract.development_access: Train and tune targets may be collected only after all model-eligible feature rows and their dataset manifest are immutable.
target_contract.test_access: Test targets may be collected once only after an immutable pretest artifact binds model, scaling, calibration, evaluation policy, dataset, implementation, and source commit.

binance_features: spot and perpetual signed aggressive quote share
spot and perpetual maximum aggregate quote
forbidden: Polymarket historical price or trade history

partition.insufficient_power: Reject or extend under a new preregistered contract. Never relax gates after test access.

candidate_contract.search: A fixed bounded regularization and tree-complexity grid only. No test-driven changes.
candidate_contract.calibration: Choose no calibration or tune-only logistic calibration using tune log loss before test access.
candidate_contract.ai: No language model is screened on this historical lane because reproducible point-in-time text inputs do not exist. AI remains veto-or-reduce only in the separately gated prospective lane.

resource_contract.network: Use bounded retries, Retry-After, request-size limits, cursor checkpoints, and no authenticated endpoint.
resource_contract.rate: At most five requests per second per public origin with no burst above five.
resource_contract.storage: Ingest one checksummed Binance day at a time, delete raw archives after certification, store canonical official payloads once, and never duplicate one-second facts.
resource_contract.memory: Process one UTC day at a time with a two-gigabyte DuckDB memory ceiling.
resource_contract.database: Use one compact DuckDB historical-screen database with separate feature and target schemas, explicit transactions, and durable phase transitions.
resource_contract.ssd: No raw archive retention, no duplicate corpus, no Polymarket trade-history copy, and no write-heavy hidden process.
